messages:
Lena Ortiz: Quick sync on postmortem action items from the autoscaler-misfire incident. I'm consolidating owners here so we can push into the remediation tracker. Please claim or nominate. Target: owners + jira links by Wednesday EOD.

Lena Ortiz: Actions we captured: 1) Add blackout windows to horizontal autoscaler to avoid mass shrink during region hiccups. 2) Improve autoscaler telemetry + tracing for decision timeline. 3) Add synthetic load tests to validate scale-down safety. 4) Create playbook for emergency scale-up and manual overrides. 5) Run retrospective queries to list all incidents with >10% capacity drop in last 6 months.

Tomás Rivera: I'll take #2 (telemetry + tracing). Will add span tags for decision reason and include rollback signals.

Tomás Rivera: Ticket created: SRE-5120 "autoscaler: decision traces + telemetry". ETA: 8 business days.

Priya Shah: I'll own #3 (synthetic load tests). Plan: add a canary job that runs scale-up and verifies pod readiness before scale-down. Will submit test harness doc.

Priya Shah: Jira: QA-3347 "synthetic scale tests for autoscaler". Assigning to Priya for draft; need infra-sre review.

Noah Green: I'll pick #1 (blackout windows). Question: do we want zone-level or region-level blackout? Lean region-level for production. Also will add config flag to override for emergency ops.

Noah Green: Ticket: TOOLS-2211 "autoscaler blackout windows + override". ETA Friday.

Lena Ortiz: For #4 (playbook) I can start the draft but would like an oncall co-author. @Tomás Rivera interested?

Tomás Rivera: Yup, I can co-author the playbook. Suggest adding explicit RACI row: Responsible = oncall, Accountable = infra-sre lead, Consulted = core infra, Informed = product + SRE.

Priya Shah: For #5 (retrospective queries) I can run initial queries if someone grants read for the old cluster logs. @OpsBot can you schedule a job to export June-Nov logs to the analytics bucket?

OpsBot: Action scheduled: export cluster logs Jun-Nov to analytics-bucket (job 2305012000). Reminder ping set for owner check-in in 2 days (2305009300).

Noah Green: One more item: add a post-deploy safety check that prevents large-scale scale-down when network error rate > threshold. I'll add as subtask in TOOLS-2211.

Priya Shah: Good call. I'll wire the synthetic test to fail if that safety check isn't present.

Lena Ortiz: I've sketched an owners table in the doc and will add Jira links after you paste them here. Also adding a column for due date and verification step.

Tomás Rivera: FYI SRE-5120 includes a dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood/d/sre/autoscaler-traces

Noah Green: TOOLS-2211 created and linked: https://redwood.app/jira/TOOLS-2211. Added proposed region-level blackout config.

Priya Shah: QA-3347 link: https://redwood.app/jira/QA-3347. Putting a note to run on staging then lower-canary prod.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks. Quick RACI confirmation: Responsible = owners above, Accountable = infra-sre manager (Samir), Consulted = runtime, Informed = product. Any objections?

Tomás Rivera: ACK.

Priya Shah: ACK.

Noah Green: ACK.

Lena Ortiz: OpsBot reminder: follow-up check in 3 days to ensure tickets have due dates and verification steps.

OpsBot: Reminder set: follow-up check in 3 days (2305010500).

Lena Ortiz: Summary: owners assigned (SRE-5120, TOOLS-2211, QA-3347), OpsBot exports scheduled, RACI agreed. I'll push to the remediation tracker after you all confirm due dates in the tickets. Thanks! :handshake:

Noah Green: Will update TOOLS-2211 with due date by EOD today.

Tomás Rivera: I'll add ETA on SRE-5120 and link test harness.

Priya Shah: I'll schedule the canary tests and post results in QA-3347.

Lena Ortiz: Closing thread for now. Ping here if blockers pop up.
